test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the given letter, number, symbol series and answer the question that follows.
 
 

(Left) K L % Y & 4 E 2 * 3 M & 7 S W # 8 2 H * L (Right)
 
 

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be eighth from the right?
solution:
Given series:-
 
 
 
 
• (Left) K L % Y & 4 E 2 * 3 M & 7 S W # 8 2 H * L (Right) 
 
• If all the numbers are dropped from the series then series given below:- 
 
• (Left) K L % Y & E * **M** & S W # H * L (Right) 
 
• M is the eighth from the right end. 
 
 

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
